Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 73 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ocean account. A bond of 43% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 374 aliases cost 156 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
